Here’s a simple rundown of your main options with us:

Trial & subscription: Start with a 2‑week trial, then it rolls into a recurring delivery every 4 weeks, which you can change or cancel anytime.
Meal plan controls: In your account you can:
Edit recipes, set them to fixed (same each box) or rotate (switch each delivery).
Choose full or half portions and how many meal packs per day.
Update your dog’s details so portions stay right.
Portion & feeding info: On your pet’s page you can always see exact portions and a step‑by‑step feeding guide.
Add or remove dogs: You can add new pups yourself and build them a custom plan; removing a dog needs help from our team and will change your pricing.
Extras: Add treats and probiotics as a one‑time add‑on or in every box, as long as you do it before your order deadline.
Where to buy: Besides subscriptions on our site, you can also buy our recipes, variety packs, and treats through PetSmart, Chewy, and Amazon, including select PetSmart stores.
Try before fully committing: You can sample recipes via a Variety Pack or single packs at our retail partners, then come back and start a personalized plan once you know what your dog loves.
